title.narrative: Improving Local Development Dynamics (ILDD) in Aswan, Egyp

description.narrative: The project aims at enhancing the role and effectiveness of civil society and local authorities to deliver inclusive and gender responsive development services in villages of four districts of Aswan governorate: Kom Ombo, Daraw, Aswan, and Edfu. In order to do this, the action has 3 specific objectives:1)To increase community participation, especially of women, in local development processes;2)To strengthen CSOs and CSO Federations to be more independent, sustainable, and results- oriented.
